illustration.captionEn: Because her job requires a lot of travel, she leads a very mobile lifestyle.
illustration.captionZh: 因為她的工作經常需要出差，所以過著相當機動的生活。

illustration.captionEn: I still have a vivid memory of my first day at school.
illustration.captionZh: 我對上學第一天仍有鮮明的記憶。

illustration.captionEn: Several customers complained to the manager about the long waiting time at the restaurant.
illustration.captionZh: 好幾位顧客向經理抱怨這間餐廳等待的時間太長。

illustration.captionEn: Grandma gently pinched the baby's chubby cheek.
illustration.captionZh: 奶奶輕輕捏了捏寶寶胖嘟嘟的臉頰。

illustration.captionEn: Doctors called her recovery a miracle.
illustration.captionZh: 醫生們稱她的康復是個奇蹟。

illustration.captionEn: The bartender refused to serve the noisy drunk any more beer.
illustration.captionZh: 酒保拒絕再賣酒給那位吵鬧的醉漢。

illustration.captionEn: There is a large portrait of my grandparents hanging in the living room.
illustration.captionZh: 客廳裡掛著一幅我祖父母的大幅肖像。

illustration.captionEn: The ancient temple was famous for its white marble columns.
illustration.captionZh: 這座古老的神殿以其潔白的大理石柱聞名。

illustration.captionEn: She carefully strung each colorful bead onto the thin wire to make a bracelet.
illustration.captionZh: 她小心翼翼地把每顆彩色珠子串到細鐵絲上，做成一條手鍊。

illustration.captionEn: The comedian's jokes were so funny that the audience burst into laughter.
illustration.captionZh: 這位喜劇演員的笑話太好笑了，觀眾們哄堂大笑。

illustration.captionEn: The children thought it was cruel to laugh at their classmate's mistake.
illustration.captionZh: 孩子們認為嘲笑同學的錯誤是很殘忍的。

illustration.captionEn: I updated the photo on my social media profile yesterday.
illustration.captionZh: 我昨天更新了社群媒體個人檔案上的照片。

illustration.captionEn: Please be patient with your little brother while he learns to ride a bike.
illustration.captionZh: 弟弟在學騎腳踏車時，請對他有耐心一點。

illustration.captionEn: These plants flourish in warm, sunny spots, so I keep them by the window.
illustration.captionZh: 這些植物在溫暖有陽光的地方長得很好，所以我把它們放在窗邊。

illustration.captionEn: The new game has amazing graphics that look almost real.
illustration.captionZh: 這款新遊戲的畫面幾乎逼真到像現實一樣。

illustration.captionEn: The family held a quiet burial for their grandfather last week.
illustration.captionZh: 這家人上週為祖父舉行了一場安靜的葬禮。

illustration.captionEn: Because the island was cut off from the mainland long ago, many species evolved differently there.
illustration.captionZh: 由於這座島嶼很久以前就與大陸分離，許多物種因此在島上演化出不同的樣貌。

illustration.captionEn: We deeply appreciate the volunteers' efforts to protect the local environment.
illustration.captionZh: 我們深深感激志工們為保護當地環境所付出的努力。

illustration.captionEn: He is a frequent customer at the coffee shop near his office.
illustration.captionZh: 他是他辦公室附近那家咖啡店的常客。

illustration.captionEn: During summer vacation, the students were free to roam around the museum in small groups.
illustration.captionZh: 暑假期間，學生們可以自由地分成小組在博物館裡到處參觀。

illustration.captionEn: She often wonders what her life would be like in another country.
illustration.captionZh: 她常常納悶自己在另一個國家生活會是什麼樣子。

illustration.captionEn: It was miraculous that no one got hurt when the tree fell on the car.
illustration.captionZh: 那棵樹倒在車上時竟然沒有人受傷，真是奇蹟。

illustration.captionEn: A tiny eyelash fell into my eye and made it water.
illustration.captionZh: 一根小睫毛掉進我的眼睛，讓眼睛流淚。

illustration.captionEn: The museum offers visitors a wealth of information about ancient civilizations.
illustration.captionZh: 這座博物館提供遊客豐富的古文明資訊。

illustration.captionEn: Having supportive friends is a real blessing in difficult times.
illustration.captionZh: 在困難的時刻，擁有支持你的朋友真的是一種福氣。

illustration.captionEn: Be careful not to crush the eggs at the bottom of the bag.
illustration.captionZh: 小心別壓破袋子底部的雞蛋。

illustration.captionEn: The movie was too violent for my little brother to watch.
illustration.captionZh: 那部電影太暴力了，我弟弟不適合看。

illustration.captionEn: It is important to be kind to classmates who are having a hard time.
illustration.captionZh: 對正經歷困難的同學友善是很重要的。

illustration.captionEn: Scientists analyzed the data before drawing any conclusions.
illustration.captionZh: 科學家在下結論前先分析了數據。

illustration.captionEn: You can find more information about the museum on its official website.
illustration.captionZh: 你可以在博物館的官方網站上找到更多資訊。
